title: Companion-style QA Assistance in Ego-Vision
abstract: arXiv:2609.06721v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI companions are envisioned as always-on assistants that support users in daily life. With this regard, we introduce BuddyVQA, a benchmark for companion-style question answering (QA) on egocentric streaming video. BuddyVQA contains 21.6K questions linked to 6K highlight moments across 1,012 long, egocentric videos. It features two key characteristics that are common in daily first-person QA assistance but are largely overlooked in existing VideoQA benchmarks: ego-deictic expressions and interactively chained questions (e.g., "Where is it?", "How to get there?"). These require models to infer a user's in-situation intent by resolving visual pronouns in the context of egocentric visual and QA contents, with both grounded in a long-form streaming setting. translated_title: 第一人称视觉中的陪伴式问答辅助
translated_abstract: AI陪伴者被设想为随时在线的助手，为用户的日常生活提供支持。为此，我们提出了BuddyVQA，一个面向第一人称（自我中心视角）流式视频的陪伴式问答（QA）基准。BuddyVQA包含21.6K个问题，关联了1,012段长第一人称视频中的6K个高光时刻。该基准具有两个在日常生活第一人称问答辅助中十分常见、却在现有视频问答（VideoQA）基准中被严重忽视的关键特征：自我指示性表达（ego-deictic expressions）和交互式链式问题（例如“它在哪里？”、“怎么去那里？”）。这些问题要求模型通过在第一人称视觉内容和问答内容的双重上下文中解析视觉代词，来推断用户在当前情境中的意图，且两者均建立在长时流式设置之上。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了MyBuddy，一个陪伴式问答助手，其核心是一种多模态思维链推理机制，可基于历史信息推断最终答案……
tldr: 该论文提出了BuddyVQA基准和MyBuddy助手，通过多模态思维链推理来处理自我指示性表达和交互式链式问题，实现第一人称流式视频中的陪伴式问答辅助。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BuddyVQA, a benchmark for companion-style QA on egocentric streaming video featuring ego-deictic expressions and interactively chained questions, along with MyBuddy, a QA assistant built on multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning.
